english.title: Cause another to distribute free printed matter without consent - Environmental Protection Act 1990
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that land, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LAND..), was designated under Schedule 3A to the Environmental Protection Act 1990, caused another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to distribute free printed matter, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MATTER..), without the consent of the principal litter authority
